description: This bar chart illustrates the macro f-score for two models, RECA and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub>, across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low. The horizontal axis represents the frequency categories, labeled “High,” “Medium,” and “Low” in that order, and appears to be categorical with no defined scale. The vertical axis is labeled “Macro f-score” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The chart features paired bars for each frequency category, with RECA represented by orange bars and GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> by brown bars. For the “High” frequency, the RECA bar has a height of approximately 0.837, while the GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar reaches 0.877.  In the “Medium” frequency, the RECA bar extends to approximately 0.538 in height, and the GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar reaches a height of approximately 0.609.  Finally, for the “Low” frequency, the RECA bar is approximately 0.114 in height and the GAIT<sub>GAT</sub> bar is approximately 0.224. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each frequency category. A legend in the lower-left corner identifies the color correspondence for each model. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
